shows.title: Legacy of the Beatles / Open Lines
shows.first_half: Today marks what would have been the 86th birthday of Beatles co-founder John Lennon. Author and historian Chuck Gunderson joins guest host Connie Willis (info) to explore the Beatles' lasting impact on music, culture, and society, tracing their rise from their early years through their 1970 breakup. He’ll revisit their explosive touring years and examine how stepping away from the road opened new creative possibilities in the studio, leading to some of their most enduring music. Followed by Open Lines in the latter half. Give Connie a call and discuss whatever is on your mind!

shows.title: Hauntings & Demonic Encounters / Dream Guidance
shows.first_half: Filmmaker and paranormal investigator Colin Browen joins Ryan Wrecker (email) for an exploration of hauntings, mysterious entities, alleged demonic encounters, and disturbing true-crime cases, examining the evidence behind some of his most unsettling investigations. Followed by dreamwork expert and psychologist Bonnie Buckner, PhD, who shares how dreams can serve as inner maps, helping us navigate life’s challenges, unlock creativity, and realize our fullest potential.
shows.second_half: 6-10pm PT: Art Bell - Somewhere in Time returns to 8/13/97, when remote viewer Ed Dames shared a variety of doom and gloom predictions.

shows.title: The Dracula Legend / Near-Death Encounters
shows.first_half: First Half: Joining Ryan Wrecker (email), author Steven J. Rolfes will explore Dracula's origins, tracing the early vampire tales and literary influences that shaped the legend. He'll include Bram Stoker's inspirations and how these stories converged to create one of the world’s most iconic monsters.
shows.second_half: Second Half: Podcast host and teacher Michael Sandler will share the extraordinary details of his two NDEs, including when he was clinically estimated to have been dead for 30 minutes. He’ll recount how a guiding presence offered glimpses of his future, and discuss his ongoing encounters with angelic presences.

shows.title: Investigating Cryptids / Earthbound Spirits
shows.first_half: First Half: Wildlife biologist and TV host Pat Spain will recount his adventures investigating cryptids and unexplained phenomena in some of the world’s most remote locations. He’ll share details of strange encounters, unexpected discoveries, and behind-the-scenes stories that never made it to air.
shows.second_half: Second Half: Medium Ellie Pechet will discuss her belief that earthbound spirits can attach themselves to the living, potentially contributing to emotional, physical, and behavioral changes. She’ll share accounts from her work detaching spirits from individuals, clearing haunted locations, and helping earthbound spirits move on.

shows.title: Star Trek Legacy / Haunted Prisons
shows.first_half: First Half: September 8, 2026, marked the 60th anniversary of Star Trek. Rod Roddenberry, son of creator Gene Roddenberry, will reflect on his father’s life and vision, share personal memories of his parents, and discuss carrying their legacy forward. He’ll also explore the story behind the original USS Enterprise model, the Roddenberry Foundation, and the future of the Star Trek universe.
shows.second_half: Second Half: Paranormal investigator and author Ross Allison will share compelling encounters from some of America’s most haunted prisons, and explain why these locations are considered paranormal hotspots.

shows.title: Psychic Crime Solving / Astrology Forecast
shows.first_half: First Half: Psychic medium Chuck Bergman will reveal how he discovered his psychic abilities and developed them during military service and 32 years in law enforcement. He’ll share stories of using his gifts in criminal investigations and explain how mediumship works, including spirit communication.
shows.second_half: Second Half: Intuitive astrologer Maria Shaw will explore the astrology of Halloween and beyond, offering predictions for 2027, a year she believes could bring significant change for us all. She’ll also examine the link between astrology and the paranormal, revealing which zodiac signs may be most likely to see ghosts.

shows.title: UFO Crash Retrievals / Negative Entities
shows.first_half: First Half: Engineer and UFO researcher Ryan S. Wood will explore UFO crash retrievals, the controversial Majestic Twelve documents, and claims of recovered nonhuman technology. He’ll discuss key witnesses and historical cases, alleged government reverse-engineering programs, and UFOdex, his AI-powered platform for analyzing UFO archives.
shows.second_half: Second Half: Psychic medium and author June Lundgren will examine the hierarchy of negative entities, how she believes they operate, and what draws them to people, places, and objects. She’ll reveal signs of spiritual attachments and ways to protect yourself and seek help.

shows.title: Physical Mediumship / Open Lines
shows.first_half: Joining guest host Rich Berra (email), physical and mental medium, author, and speaker Julie Adreani will discuss her work in physical mediumship under red light. She’ll explore the role of a trusted, dedicated circle and describe séance phenomena, including transfiguration and other forms of spirit activity. She'll also share her journey into mediumship, her training, and personal encounters involving spirits and extraterrestrials. Followed by Open Lines in the latter half. Give Rich a call and discuss whatever is on your mind!
